entities.name: Tim
entities.description: One of the two speakers. A student and a fantasy-literature enthusiast, above all of Harry Potter: he ran a Harry Potter fan project from May 2023, joined a fantasy literature forum in June 2023, wrote articles about fantasy novels for an online magazine from August 2023 and was writing his own fantasy novel by October 2023. He learned the piano from August 2023, the violin from December 2023 and German by January 2024, joined a travel club in December 2023, and was accepted onto a study abroad programme in Galway, Ireland on 5 January 2024. He has never played on a sports team. He met John on 21 May 2023.

entities.name: John
entities.description: One of the two speakers. A professional basketball player, a shooting guard who signed with the Minnesota Wolves shortly before 21 May 2023 and had been playing professionally for just under a year by December 2023. He surfs, cooks, hikes and took up yoga in December 2023, married his girlfriend in the week before 2 October 2023, mentored younger players from October 2023, was injured in November 2023, and built up endorsements from Nike in July 2023 to an outdoor gear company in December 2023 and a beverage company in January 2024. He met Tim on 21 May 2023.

entities.name: John's wife
entities.description: John's girlfriend and, from the week before 2 October 2023, his wife. Never named. They married in an emotional greenhouse ceremony, had their first dance at a cosy restaurant, took a European vacation together in November 2023 and hosted a get-together in December 2023 to celebrate John's recovery milestone. Referred to as 'my girlfriend', 'my wife' and 'the bride'.

entities.name: John's father
entities.description: John's father, who watched NBA games with him when he was a child and signed him up for a local basketball league when he turned ten — the start of John's basketball career.

entities.name: Anthony
entities.description: A friend of John's. He and John went to a charity event together that included a Harry Potter trivia contest, which John described to Tim on 2 August 2023 and referred back to on 8 December 2023.

entities.name: Tim's Harry Potter fan friend in California
entities.description: A Harry Potter fan in California whom Tim talks to about his fan project. Referred to as 'my friend who is a fan of Harry Potter' on 21 May 2023, as 'a Harry Potter fan in California' on 16 July 2023 and as 'that Harry Potter fan I met in CA' on 9 August 2023; these mentions are joined here because each is of a Harry Potter fan Tim discusses fan-project collaboration with, though the conversation never names the person.

properties.aliases: the Harry Potter fan in California; that HP fan I met in CA; my friend who is a fan of Harry Potter

entities.name: LeBron James
entities.description: The basketball player both Tim and John name as their favourite. John admires his skills, leadership, work ethic and dedication, has met him a few times and has seen him play live; Tim owns a basketball signed by him and calls his chase-down block in Game 7 of the 2016 Finals inspiring. Referred to as 'LeBron'.

entities.name: J.K. Rowling
entities.description: The author of the Harry Potter books and Tim's greatest writing inspiration. He has read her work for a long time, admires her detail and storytelling, takes notes on her style for his own writing, and quotes her line 'Turn on the light - happiness hides in the darkest of times'.

entities.name: Patrick Rothfuss
entities.description: The author of 'The Name of the Wind', which Tim recommended to John on 9 August 2023, again on 11 August 2023 and 21 September 2023, and was reading himself on 7 January 2024.

entities.name: George R. R. Martin
entities.description: The author of the Game of Thrones books. Tim has read that series and finished 'A Dance with Dragons' shortly before 8 December 2023; John had read none of his books as of that date.

entities.name: Emma Watson
entities.description: The lead actress in the Harry Potter films. Tim identified her for John on 26 December 2023 and said he is a huge fan of her advocacy for gender equality and women's rights.

entities.name: Frank Herbert
entities.description: The author of 'Dune', the book John was reading on 8 December 2023.

entities.name: Minnesota Wolves
entities.description: The professional basketball team John signed with shortly before 21 May 2023 and plays shooting guard for. Referred to as 'the Wolves' and 'my team'. Over 2023 the team welcomed him, won a trophy, and became what he calls a second family; he mentored its younger players from October 2023.

entities.name: Nike
entities.description: The sports brand John was considering for endorsements on 15 June 2023 and had signed a basketball shoe and gear deal with by 16 July 2023.

entities.name: Under Armour
entities.description: A sports brand John was considering for endorsements on 15 June 2023 and said on 16 July 2023 he had always liked and would love to work with. No deal with them is reported.

entities.name: Gatorade
entities.description: The brand John said on 16 July 2023 he was in talks with about a potential sponsorship.

entities.name: the online fantasy magazine Tim writes for
entities.description: An online magazine, never named, that Tim has written articles about fantasy novels for since around August 2023. He found the opportunity on a fantasy literature forum and pitched his own ideas to them. His articles study characters and themes and make book recommendations.

entities.name: the fantasy literature forum
entities.description: An online forum Tim joined on 14 June 2023 and where he had an enriching talk about his favourite books. It is also where he found the magazine writing opportunity he took up in August 2023.

entities.name: the travel club Tim joined
entities.description: A club of travel enthusiasts Tim joined shortly before 6 December 2023, drawn by an interest in different cultures and countries. Described again on 2 January 2024 as 'a group of globetrotters who are into the same stuff as me'; the two mentions are joined here because both are of a travel-enthusiast group Tim had recently joined and enjoyed hearing trip stories from.

properties.aliases: a group of globetrotters; the globetrotting group

entities.name: John's hiking club
entities.description: A hiking club John had only just joined by early October 2023; some of its members came to his wedding.

entities.name: the local youth sports organisation John works with
entities.description: A local organisation, never named, that helps disadvantaged children with sports and school. John began teaming up with it around 11 August 2023 and by 26 December 2023 was working with organisations on youth sports and fair access to sport for underserved communities.

entities.name: MinaLima
entities.description: The studio that created the props for the Harry Potter films. Tim owns one of their pictures, which hangs by his bookshelf, and admires their work.

entities.name: Tim's school
entities.description: The school or college Tim attends; never named. The source of the assignments, exams, class presentation and English literature class he describes between August 2023 and December 2023, and of the study abroad programme he was accepted onto on 5 January 2024.

entities.name: London
entities.description: The city where Tim visited a Harry Potter attraction and took a tour a few years before 21 May 2023, which he said was like walking into a Harry Potter movie.

entities.name: the United Kingdom
entities.description: Tim's Harry Potter conference in the week before 13 October 2023 was held here, he read a book about its castles in October 2023, he visited a castle here on 10 November 2023, and he tried to write a story based on the trip in November 2023. Referred to as 'the UK'.

entities.name: Scotland
entities.description: The country Edinburgh is in, named by Tim on 21 September 2023 when he suggested the city for John's team trip.

entities.name: Edinburgh
entities.description: The Scottish city Tim recommended for John's team trip on 21 September 2023, calling it the birthplace of Harry Potter with great history, architecture and a magical vibe. John had not been.

entities.name: Seattle
entities.description: One of John's favourite cities to explore, where he had a game due in August 2023. He loves its energy, diversity, food and fans, and rates the local seafood a must.

entities.name: Chicago
entities.description: The city John travelled to for several days shortly before 11 August 2023. He loved its energy and found the locals friendly.

entities.name: New York City
entities.description: A city John has visited and calls a must-visit for its culture and food, though he struggled with the subway at first. Tim added it to his travel list on 26 August 2023. Referred to as 'NYC'.

entities.name: Universal Studios
entities.description: The theme park Tim was planning his first visit to for September 2023, most excited about the Harry Potter attractions. John had not been but had it on his bucket list.

entities.name: the Smoky Mountains
entities.description: Where Tim took a photograph of a sunset over the mountains, on a trip he described on 17 October 2023 both as last summer and as the previous year.

entities.name: the Rocky Mountains
entities.description: Where John took a trip in 2022 that he found stunning, with mountains and fresh air that made him realise how incredible the world is.

entities.name: Galway
entities.description: The Irish city Tim was to stay in for his study abroad semester from February 2024, chosen for its arts, Irish music and vibrant atmosphere.

entities.name: Ireland
entities.description: The country Tim was due to spend a study abroad semester in from February 2024, staying in Galway and hoping to explore its nature and the Cliffs of Moher.

entities.name: the Cliffs of Moher
entities.description: The Irish cliffs Tim wanted to visit during his semester abroad, for their ocean views; John said he might stop by after his season.

entities.name: Italy
entities.description: Where John travelled in December 2023, loving the food, history and architecture and buying a cookbook that has since given him cooking inspiration. It is on Tim's list of places to visit.

entities.name: Paris
entities.description: The city John has visited and loved, showing Tim a photograph of the Eiffel Tower on 2 January 2024 and calling the view from it incredible. Tim has not been.

entities.name: Barcelona
entities.description: The city John recommended to Tim on 12 January 2024 as a must-visit for its culture, architecture, food and nearby beaches. Tim added it to his list.

entities.name: California
entities.description: Where the Harry Potter fan Tim talks to about his fan project lives. Referred to as 'CA'.

entities.name: Europe
entities.description: Where John and his wife went on a short vacation from around 6 November 2023, road tripping along the European coastline; it was over by 11 November 2023.

entities.name: John's hometown
entities.description: The town John grew up in and returned to in the week before 26 August 2023 to see family and old friends; a tranquil forest near it is one of his favourite photographs, and he ran a week-long basketball camp for children there in the summer of 2023. Never named.

entities.name: John's gym
entities.description: The gym John found shortly before 21 August 2023 to keep up his basketball fitness, after a difficult search. It is where he rebuilt a routine combining basketball work and strength training, and where he jogged without pain for the first time after his injury on 15 December 2023. Never named.

entities.name: Harry Potter
entities.description: The book and film series at the centre of Tim's enthusiasm: his fan project, his collaboration with a fan in California, the MinaLima print by his bookshelf, his themed Christmas tree, the conference he attended in the UK in October 2023 and the party he went to in December 2023. John owns the whole film collection and went to a Harry Potter trivia contest at a charity event. Referred to as 'HP'.

entities.name: Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone
entities.description: The first Harry Potter film, which Tim watched with his family and remembers as magical; its theme is his favourite piece to play on the piano. John said on 21 August 2023 that he loves it too.

entities.name: Game of Thrones
entities.description: One of Tim's two favourite series alongside Harry Potter, still his favourite on 21 November 2023. It is the only part of George R. R. Martin's work he has read, and he analysed it for his English literature class in December 2023. Referred to as 'GoT'.

entities.name: A Dance with Dragons
entities.description: The Game of Thrones novel Tim had just finished before 8 December 2023 and recommended to John.

entities.name: The Name of the Wind
entities.description: The Patrick Rothfuss fantasy novel Tim recommended to John on 11 August 2023, praising its magician-and-musician protagonist, world-building and character development. He recommended a Patrick Rothfuss novel again on 9 August 2023 and 21 September 2023, and was reading this one himself on 7 January 2024.

entities.name: The Alchemist
entities.description: The book John read and loved for making him think about following his dreams, which he reread shortly before 21 November 2023. Tim read it earlier and says it changed his perspective on his goals; he spotted it on John's bookshelf on 21 September 2023.

entities.name: Dune
entities.description: The Frank Herbert novel John was reading on 8 December 2023, which he described as a story about religion and human control over ecology.

entities.name: The Hobbit
entities.description: One of John's favourite books, which he spotted on Tim's reorganised bookshelf on 1 December 2023.

entities.name: The Lord of the Rings
entities.description: Tim's favourite fantasy film, shown on 26 December 2023, and John's favourite fantasy film series for its adventure, world and characters. John's favourite character is Aragorn. Tim also owns a map of Middle-earth from it. Referred to as 'LOTR'.

entities.name: Star Wars
entities.description: Tim's favourite film series, which he said on 2 January 2024 never gets old.

entities.name: Home Alone
entities.description: One of the films Tim's family watch together at Thanksgiving; he says it always brings lots of laughs.

entities.name: Elf
entities.description: One of the films Tim's family watch over the holidays, which makes them laugh and feel festive.

entities.name: The Santa Clause
entities.description: A film Tim's family watch over the holidays and find heartwarming; John agrees it captures the Christmas magic.

entities.name: The Wheel of Time
entities.description: A new fantasy television series, based on a book series Tim loves, that he said on 26 December 2023 was coming out the following month and that he could not wait to watch.

entities.name: basketball
entities.description: John's sport and profession. He started as a child watching NBA games with his father, played a local league from age ten, through middle and high school, on a college scholarship, and was drafted after college. He plays shooting guard, mentors younger players, trains daily, and works to give other children access to the sport.

entities.name: surfing
entities.description: John's other sport, taken up around 2018. He loves the waves, the wind and the connection to nature, and remembers a whole summer surfing with friends.

entities.name: reading fantasy literature
entities.description: Tim's lifelong pursuit and his escape from reality: Harry Potter and Game of Thrones above all, plus Patrick Rothfuss, self-improvement books and travellers' stories. It underpins his forum membership, his magazine articles and his own novel. John read more from late 2023 partly on Tim's recommendations.

entities.name: Tim's writing
entities.description: Tim's own writing: articles about fantasy novels for an online magazine from August 2023, a fantasy novel in progress from October 2023 that survived a plot-twist block in November 2023, and a story based on his UK trip that did not turn out as he wanted later that month. He draws inspiration from books, films, real life and J.K. Rowling's style.

entities.name: playing the piano
entities.description: Tim started learning the piano around August 2023 and had been playing about four months as of 6 December 2023. His favourite piece is the theme from 'Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone'.

entities.name: playing the violin
entities.description: Tim started learning the violin shortly before 6 December 2023. He is mostly into classical music but wants to try jazz and film scores.

entities.name: cooking
entities.description: John's therapy away from the court: a creative way to experiment with flavours. He improvised a sage soup in August 2023, makes honey garlic chicken with roasted vegetables regularly, and bought a cookbook in Italy in December 2023.

entities.name: yoga
entities.description: Taken up by John by 1 December 2023 for strength and flexibility. He says it also improved his focus and balance; Warrior II is a favourite pose and he holds poses 30 to 60 seconds.

entities.name: hiking
entities.description: John hikes — he joined a hiking club by October 2023, found his outdoor-gear photoshoot spot while hiking, and was given hiking gear in that December 2023 deal. Tim counts hiking among his favourite things to do with friends and family and was moved by a book story about two hikers in the Himalayas.

entities.name: John's lucky basketball shoes
entities.description: The shoes John has worn since the beginning of his basketball journey. He says every mark has a story and that they symbolise resilience, determination and his love of the game.

entities.name: John's basketball signed by his teammates
entities.description: The ball John's Minnesota Wolves teammates signed and gave him when he rejoined them on 15 August 2023, as a sign of friendship and appreciation. He keeps it as a reminder of their bond and of why he started playing.

entities.name: Tim's basketball signed by LeBron James
entities.description: Tim's prized possession, a basketball signed by his favourite player, kept in a case as a reminder of hard work.

entities.name: Tim's book collection
entities.description: Tim's shelves of fantasy novels, shown to John several times between June 2023 and January 2024 and reorganised shortly before 1 December 2023. A MinaLima Harry Potter print hangs with them.

entities.name: John's basketball jersey collection
entities.description: The basketball jerseys John collects, shown to Tim on 21 May 2023 and again on 2 October 2023.

entities.name: John's November 2023 injury
entities.description: The injury John picked up in the week before 16 November 2023. His doctor said it was not too serious, but it kept him off the court and made him miss games. He did physical therapy exercises daily and jogged without pain for the first time on 15 December 2023. Distinct from the ankle injury he had in an earlier season.

entities.name: Tim's Harry Potter fan project
entities.description: The fan project Tim was working on from May 2023, discussing collaborations around the Harry Potter universe — characters, spells and magical creatures — with a Harry Potter fan in California.

entities.name: Tim's fantasy novel
entities.description: The fantasy novel Tim was in the middle of writing by 21 October 2023. He found it nerve-wracking and exciting, got stuck on a plot twist in the week before 6 November 2023, and worked his way out of it.

entities.name: Tim's semester abroad in Ireland
entities.description: The study abroad programme Tim applied for and was accepted onto on 5 January 2024, taking him to Galway, Ireland for a semester from February 2024.
